verdict.rationale: Controlling data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a desktop coding-agent app backed by a hosted model catalog, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented retention settings, chat or history deletion, or data-deletion controls. The only nearby evidence is the `--password-store` option for choosing a credential keyring, which is an adjacent control and not retention or deletion management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
